method: These seven landscape chapters draw on longer visits in a locally held timeline, from mid-November 2025 through mid-November 2026. The available record ends in October 2026. Nearby visits are grouped into broad artistic regions; their names are approximate, not mapped boundaries. Month bands show when a chapter appears, and the reading order follows its first appearance. A visit record is not a campsite. The field studio is a shared artistic setting for exploring these landscapes.

chapters.title: Southern Tablelands & Canberra region
chapters.landscape_copy: Open grasslands meet wooded ridges. A chapter of broad skies, cool light and the meeting of country and city.

chapters.title: South Coast
chapters.landscape_copy: Forest approaches the shore. Sea light, weathered wood and sheltered waterways bring the living coast into the field studio.

chapters.title: High country & eastern Victoria
chapters.landscape_copy: Layered ranges, tall forest and cooler air shape a mountain palette. Distance appears in successive shades of blue and green.

chapters.title: Riverina
chapters.landscape_copy: River country and open plains invite a slower view. Muted greens and warm ground colours follow the changing light.

chapters.title: Central Victoria
chapters.landscape_copy: Dry woodland and open country carry a quieter palette of straw, bark and stone. Long light draws out the folds of the land.

chapters.title: North-west NSW & western slopes
chapters.landscape_copy: The horizon opens across plains and slopes. Earth, grass and changing skies give this chapter its sense of space.

chapters.title: Northern Rivers & far north coast
chapters.landscape_copy: Rain-green hills, river valleys and coastal light suggest a softer, more abundant landscape. Water connects the forest with the sea.

projection.method: Allowlisted chapter properties decoded from the native Q42 reader; field-studio hasChapter membership, ordered by relative_order.
